title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libXtst security update
description: A denial of service vulnerability (CVE-2026-94286) exists in the X.Org X11 libXtst runtime library due to an out-of-bounds read in the RECORD reply parser. This issue affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 Update Services for SAP Solutions and related variants. Red Hat has issued a security advisory with an update to address this vulnerability.
